description:
Get a free LiquidVision API key for this agent's owner, by email, without a browser.
    Works for a NEW email only (an existing account's key is never returned; its owner sees it
    at liquidvision.app/data). Use the key as X-API-Key on REST or on this MCP endpoint: 120 req/min
    instead of the shared anonymous budget, plus 100 metered calls a day (history, positions:
    get_funding_history, get_open_interest_history, get_funding_settlements, get_hl_whales, get_history...),
    and to upgrade later to Pro/Bot (unlimited, exports, webhook alerts). Ask the user for the email
    first; do not invent one.
name: get_api_key
